name: Skeletal Hearts
source:
Years after the end of a zombie outbreak, remnants still linger—in broken cities, in forgotten bunkers, and in the people who carry its scars.

And still, the seasons change.

It is the year 2040, 13 years after the outbreak ravished the world. You play as Caolan, a self-identified hermit living in the small society of the Sanctuary. As he navigates grief, mental health struggles, and a deep sense of disconnection, he may find solace in one of three men.

[From [url=https://loooneify.itch.io/skeletal-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
僵尸爆发结束多年后，残余物仍然存在——在破碎的城市中，在被遗忘的掩体中，在带有伤痕的人们身上。

尽管如此，季节仍在变化。

现在是2040年，也就是疫情席卷全球13年后。你扮演曹兰，一个自称为隐士的人，生活在庇护所的小社会里。当他应对悲伤、心理健康问题和深深的脱节感时，他可能会在三个男人中的一个身上找到安慰。

[来自[url=https://loooneify.itch.io/skeletal-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
